33451: The series' protagonist. A young arms dealer and the daughter of Floyd Hekmatyar, a global shipping magnate. Belongs to HCLI's European and African Logistics Division.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
36566: A child soldier. His parents were killed by an airstrike by a F-22 Raptor. Picked up as a child soldier soon after this traumatic event. Despite his intense hatred of weapons, Jonah decides to work under the enigmatic arms dealer, Koko Hekmatyar.
38954: An ex-mechanized jäger major of the Finnish Rapid Deployment Force who is skilled with knives. She is in love with Koko, but it is unknown whether Koko returns her feelings. Her real name is Sofia Velmer.
40941: The oldest member of Koko's crew and the second in command. A former Delta Force operator who used to be active in Somalia during the 1990s, he is a veteran mercenary with strong leadership skills.
59319: A former artillery officer from an Asian country, he was discharged from the military after a deadly training accident and was later recruited by Koko. He is the only member on Koko's team that has a family. He is put in charge of giving Jonah science lessons.
59321: A former operator of the Japanese Ministry of Defense's secret SR unit. Tojo had seen action in several black ops operations, including Cuba. He left SR and was recruited by Kasper within 20 minutes. His full name is Akihiko Tojo. He is put in charge of giving Jonah Math lessons.
59329: A former police sniper who was once part of the counter-terrorist unit, until he becomes one of Koko's mercenaries.
59435: An Afro-American explosive expert and ex-lieutenant of the 20th Engineer Brigade of the XVIII Airborne Corps in the US Army. Graduated from University of Virginia School of Architecture.
59437: He is one of Koko's bodyguards who also serves as her driver, he was also a former Mafia enforcer.
59439: A former Italian Army Bersaglieri intelligence officer who now works for Koko.
61759: Koko's older brother. He is the one who sold the weapons responsible for the death of Jonah's parents, and also the reason Jonah joined up with Koko. He always has his bodyguard Chiquita with him.
61763: Kasper's ruthless head of security and Lehm's ex-wife. Both Chiquita and Lehm used to serve as Floyd Hekmatyar's bodyguards. She can be considered the best bodyguard in HCLI.
61911: One of Curry's bodyguard. She has a obsessive crush with Valmet, who she admires as a fellow warrior. Mildo is a knife-trained mercenary and as such, prefers using combat knives and machetes as her main weapon.
61913: Curry's other bodyguard. Unlike Mildo, Lu is more calmer than her.
61957: She is an assassin from orchestra.
63853: A CIA asset in South Africa assigned to work with Scarecrow. She's more sympathetic to Koko and secretly works as Koko's informant.
64939: A corrupt CIA agent who works with Schokolade, He is an arrogant and blunt person and dislikes Koko Hekmatyar.
64959: She is a Japanese expert in robotics, working for Koko and other companies (though she wanted to use her knowledge to make toys at first). She is also a butterfly fanatic and spend most of her time hunting them. She and Koko have a secret plan going on codenamed "Jormungand".
65311: The Head of Daxinghai who is always seen with a cane. Under his polite and well mannered appearance is a ruthless man willing to do anything for the interest of China. Held a rank of major general in the PLA.
65583: A weapons dealer and head of CCAT. Ex-RAF. A British corporation and Koko's rival weapons dealer.
65585: A former lieutenant in the People's Liberation Army. Officially she is Chen's secretary but actually,​ she serves as his bodyguard as well as the commander of his soldiers. She tries to avenge Chen after his death but is injured by Jonah.
66599: A young girl who works with Boss Dominique.
72199: He was introduced in the very last part of the episode of season 1 as a shrewd CIA operative, who is tasked to not only monitor Koko, but to also put her under the agency's control under the so-called​ "Operation Undershaft."
77689: His is a ruthless gun for hire who is known for his flair of massacre, he was also Chinatsu's mentor.
82663: A former actress turned arms dealer. Although the antagonist of the Mondo Grosso Arc, after she reached an arrangement with Koko Hekmatyar she afterwards begins to conduct business with her.
82665: Former People's Liberation Army officer who served as Chan Guoming's bodyguard and driver, later succeeding Karen Low as his head of security.
82667: Leader of the Balkan Dragons militia and an internationally wanted criminal. He is the antagonist of the Dragon Shooter Arc.
82713: One of Minami Amada's three secretaries. He also served as her bodyguard until he was replaced in this capacity by Karen Lo.
